main.description: A signed public comment on a URL, DOI or content hash, optionally anchored to a passage.

subject.description: What the statement is about: an https URL (normalised: lowercase scheme and host, no fragment), a doi: URI, or a sha256: content hash written as a URI (sha256:<hex>).

anchor.description: Optional selector for a passage of the subject (a text quote or a CSS selector).

signatures.description: Inline signatures per the ATProtocol Attestation Specification; attest requires one from the author's device key (did:key, delegated from their passkey).
